name: work-tracker
title: Work Tracker
description: Log time, run the timer, check your balance, log calls and see vacation left in WorkTracker, through the app's assistant server
author: 0xlukas

commands.name: view-today
commands.title: View Today
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Today's entries, hours and balance, with earlier days a dropdown away. Add, edit or delete entries.

commands.name: add-entry
commands.title: Add Work Entry
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Add a time entry: day, start, end, project and note.

commands.name: timer
commands.title: Start or Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Start WorkTracker's timer for a project, or stop it and save the time.

commands.name: balance
commands.title: Work Balance
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Hours and balance for today, this week, month and year, all-time overtime, vacation left and days without entries.

commands.name: log-call
commands.title: Log Call
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Log a call: caller, topic, department, length and who solved it.

commands.name: vacation
commands.title: Vacation Left
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: This year's vacation allowance, the days used and other absences. Record or remove absences.

commands.name: days-without-entries
commands.title: Days Without Entries
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Past working days with no entries and no absence. Fill them in or record an absence.

commands.name: daily-quote
commands.title: Daily Quote
commands.subtitle: Work Tracker
commands.description: Today's quote, the same one WorkTracker shows on launch.

preferences.name: serverKey
preferences.title: Assistant Key
preferences.description: Leave empty: the extension reads the key from WorkTracker. Only for another WorkTracker build (for example a test build); set Port too.

preferences.name: serverPort
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Leave empty: the extension reads the port from WorkTracker (47615 by default). Only with Assistant Key, for another WorkTracker build.
